reviews.author: IAjit85
reviews.body:
I gave this 3 stars because I haven’t tested other features yet, but it failed completely at my primary purpose: reliable audio and video calling at sea.
Downloaded Arattai hoping for low-data calls to save bandwidth onboard ship, but WhatsApp audio is far clearer with no lag. Arattai voice calls stutter constantly and sound muffled—unusable for proper conversation. Even IMO offers better voice clarity.
Switched back to WhatsApp despite higher data use. Devs, please prioritize fixing audio/video quality!
